mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT d."date", COUNT(m.MEMBER_ID) AS "users" FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 7 + LEVEL, 'MM-DD') AS "date" FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) d LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON TO_CHAR(m.SIGNUP_DATE, 'MM-DD') = d."date" GROUP BY d."date" ORDER BY d."date" ASC

SELECT "title", SUM("views") AS "views", SUM("wishes") AS "wishes", SUM("score") AS "score" FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN w.LCLSF_NM LIKE '%주거%' THEN '주거' WHEN w.LCLSF_NM LIKE '%일자리%' THEN '일자리' WHEN w.LCLSF_NM LIKE '%참여%' THEN '참여·기반' WHEN w.LCLSF_NM LIKE '%교육%' THEN '교육' WHEN w.LCLSF_NM LIKE '%금융%' OR w.LCLSF_NM LIKE '%복지%' THEN '금융·복지·문화' ELSE '기타' END AS "title", NVL(b.total_views, 0) AS "views", NVL(wh.total_wishes, 0) AS "wishes", (NVL(b.total_views, 0) + NVL(wh.total_wishes, 0)) AS "score" FROM WELFARE w LEFT JOIN ( SELECT WELFARE_ID, SUM(VIEWS) AS total_views FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE = 'REV' GROUP BY WELFARE_ID ) b ON w.WELFARE_ID = b.WELFARE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT WELFARE_ID, COUNT(*) AS total_wishes FROM WISH GROUP BY WELFARE_ID ) wh ON w.WELFARE_ID = wh.WELFARE_ID ) WHERE "title" != '기타' GROUP BY "title" ORDER BY "score" DESC

SELECT M.EMAIL, MD.NAME, M.NICKNAME, MD.BIRTH_DATE, MD.GENDER, MD.PHONE, MD.REGION, MD.JOB_STATUS, MD.INCOME_LEVEL, MD.PROFILE_IMG, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND BOARD_STATUS = 'Y') AS BOARD_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISH WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) AS WISH_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPLY WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND REPLY_STATUS = 'Y') AS REPLY_COUNT FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT B.BOARD_ID, B.BOARD_TYPE, B.BOARD_TITLE, B.VIEWS, B.CREATE_DATE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIKES WHERE BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID) AS LIKES FROM BOARD B WHERE B.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND B.BOARD_STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT R.REPLY_ID AS replyId, R.REPLY_CONTENT AS replyContent, R.CREATE_DATE AS createDate, R.CODE AS code, B.BOARD_TYPE AS boardType, B.BOARD_ID AS boardId FROM REPLY R JOIN BOARD B ON B.BOARD_ID = ( CASE WHEN R.CODE = 'B' THEN R.REF_ID WHEN R.CODE = 'R' THEN (SELECT P.REF_ID FROM REPLY P WHERE P.REPLY_ID = R.REF_ID) END ) WHERE R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY R.CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
AND (EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

SELECT MEMBER_ID AS memberId, EMAIL AS email, NICKNAME AS nickname, SIGNUP_DATE AS signupDate FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_STATUS = #{status}
AND (EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY SIGNUP_DATE ASC
ORDER BY NICKNAME ASC
ORDER BY SIGNUP_DATE DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET MEMBER_STATUS = 'BANNED', DELETED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE MEMBER SET MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE', DELETED_DATE = NULL WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
